_comment: Adelaide Culinary Institute. MEASURED — three templates supplied and measured with Measure-Template.ps1 on 2026-09-01. Same legal entity as Adelaide Construction Institute (Bush Tukka Pty Ltd, RTO 45797, CRICOS 03978F) trading under a second name, but the two sets of templates are NOT the same files: different placeholder colour, different RTO row treatment, different document numbers. They are registered separately and deliberately.

rto.identityLine: Bush Tukka Pty Ltd T/A Adelaide Culinary Institute (ACI)  ·  RTO 45797  ·  CRICOS 03978F

_variantComment: Resolved from the unit's training package, not from what the user types. An SIT unit is Adelaide Culinary Institute; a CPC unit is Adelaide Construction Institute. A BSB unit takes the variant of the qualification it sits in — ask where that is not obvious. Never guess a trading name onto a student record.
_rtoRowComment: MEASURED: all three templates PRE-FILL the RTO row with the identity line — SAR details row 2, marking record header table, feedback sheet details row 2. No '[ Insert RTO name and code ]' field exists in any of them. This is the OPPOSITE of the construction variant, which leaves the row as a field.
_stylingComment: MEASURED: 9AA3B2, italic — 24 fields in the SAR, 159 in the marking record, 51 in the feedback sheet. This is NOT MVC's grey (8E96A3) nor the construction variant's (8A939C). Using the wrong value makes the gate's NoPlaceholderStyling check blind to a field that was never filled.

sar._tableComment: SIX tables, not MVC's five. ACI pulls the result-codes legend out into its own table 3, which pushes Reasonable adjustment to 4, certification to 5 and admin to 6. Copying MVC's indices here would fill the Reasonable adjustment panel with the certification block.

outcomeRows._cloneComment: MEASURED: row 3 carries the vMerge MASTER cell ('Evidence to be attached') spanning the tool block; row 4 is the continuation. CLONE ROW 4, NEVER ROW 3 — cloning the master duplicates the merge and splits the panel.

rowLayout.2: column headings: S, NYS, Feedback to student

outcomeRows._rowLayoutComment: Six rows, not MVC's seven — the result-codes row lives in table 3 here rather than as row 7 of this table.

labels.corrections: Please make corrections — resubmit both this and the corrected 2nd attempt

reEnrol.label: Re-enrol in unit of competency, as the 2nd attempt of assessment is not satisfactory

checkboxes._verifiedLabelComment: MEASURED character for character, including the EM DASH (U+2014) in the 'corrections' label. Identical to MVC's labels.

certification: has been advised of the result
_otherStandingLabels._certificationComment: 'is Competent' and 'is Not Yet Competent' SHARE ONE PARAGRAPH. Matching each with its box glyph as a prefix is what stops the first from matching inside the second.
admin: Results updated in the student management system
Assessment scanned and stored in the student management system
Feedback / appeals information sent to the student

students.heading: S. No. | Student First Name | Student Surname | Student ID | Assessment Tools | Results

amrr._tableComment: Table 4 is the result-codes legend and carries no field. Structurally identical to MVC's marking record.

groupedHeaderRow._comment: Row 1 is a grouped header: 'Assessment Tools' spans the tool block and must take a WIDER gridSpan when a tool column is inserted, not a new cell.

amrr._multiToolVerified: VERIFIED 1 September 2026 against this template at three tools and at four. The new column is inserted INSIDE the tool block, so the grouped header widens 'Assessment Tools' and leaves 'Results' at span 3. Three tools gives 12 grid columns summing to 14822; four gives 13, also summing to 14822. Both were built and passed the full gate. See references/template-fill.md.

items.heading: Questions and Tasks to be Fixed and Resubmitted

feedback._tableComment: THREE tables, not MVC's two. ACI gives the item rows a table of their own instead of continuing the details table, so itemTable.table names it explicitly. Leave that key off and the builder reads the details table, finds no item rows, and stops.

itemTable._rowComment: MEASURED: table 2 holds 12 rows — row 1 the banner, row 2 the column headings, rows 3-12 the ten item rows.
itemTable._cellComment: MEASURED: item rows carry 5 cells across a 5-column grid, one cell per column — no gridSpan, unlike MVC's.
itemTable._overflowComment: Ten items is one page. Where a student has more, the ten most significant are listed and the builder adds a closing note carrying the rest. The gate's FeedbackSheetOnePage check renders the file and blocks on two.

fields._orderComment: Fill 'dd / mm / yyyy or N/A' BEFORE 'dd / mm / yyyy', so a template revision that drops a bracket cannot silently strand ' or N/A' on a student's sheet.

markedAssessment.notSatisfactoryText: Not yet Satisfactory - refer to feedback sheet
markedAssessment.referralText: See your Student Feedback Sheet for the items to correct and the resubmission date.
markedAssessment.observationCompletedText: Observation completed by the assessor on
